translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nabz ne Devet kx yrbzle mz kxrmailz ngr dzbe kxnzngrng.

content.text: Yawe, arlapxbz ninge mz kxdrka'-ngrng
Kcng tzsuti drtwrdr nzatrkati-krdr ninge.
Nzryrlq-zvzng drtwr kxtrka mz nabzdr,
X nzapqtr-zvzlr drtwr ngr nzotangr.
Natqdr nzlvati apule nipna kr ningidoe kc tqrtq,
Mz nzrpikitingr x nzrpibqtingr.
Yawe, arlapxbz ninge mz zmatq ngrdr.
X aclve-angidrbz ninge mz krkcng tzryrlqng drtwr kx na-atrkati-ngrdr ninge.
Sc tzglqpx-lzbqng nzamwi-kapqlr trtxki kx naprtz-ngrne mz nzatu-krdr br mz nzti rnge.
X tzryrlqng drtwr kx nalolvz-ngrdr ninge.
Yawe, xlrm nzkrka'-krnge,
Murde rpi-zvzbo bam kx, “Yawe, nim Gct rnge.”
Kxetu rnge, nzxplr-krm arlapxle ninge.
X amyaq narnge mz nzvecngr.
Bzkq rlr-ngrbzme nzngidatikr drtwr kcng tzyrlq kxdrka'-ngrng lcng
Mz nzbilvz-krdr nzlolvz-krdr ninge, kxmule-esz' nzsuti zlwz drtwrdr.
Enqmi lcng tztu-ngalelvzlr ninge.
Batrpz nzayzlu-krbz badr natq ngr zngya kcng tzpimlr bange, murde nangq-moule nidr.
X nyr natatiom nangc-ngrdr,
X nartctiongr nidr mz gq kx trnarlapx-ngrdru.
Suti drtwrnge kx krkcng tzpokiang nzmnc-krdr mz drtc' natangqneo.
X da kxtrka nadwatibzle krkcng tzota-zvzng mz nzodati-krde nidr.
Yawe, krlzx kx tu-zvzbzme mz nibr kx trpnzngr scde zmatq,
X okatrq kxnzkxpung mz nzatubqti-krm da kx vz-rbr.
Leplz kxnztubqng sa na-awibzng bam,
X namnc-zvzamu badr.
